prompts.DeepSeek:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: transparent Ren'Py character expression sprite atlas.
Edit target: the attached existing community AI girl artwork. Preserve this EXACT character design, clothing, hair, accessories, original illustration style and body proportions. Do not redesign or modernize the outfit.
Produce ONE square transparent PNG sprite atlas with exactly 3 equal columns and 2 equal rows, six independent FULL BODY copies of this same character, one centered inside each cell. Each cell has identical scale, pose, head position and foot baseline. All shoes, hair, wings/tails and accessories fit fully inside its own cell with transparent margins, never cross a cell boundary. At least 2048x2048 output if possible. No panels, lines, labels, text, shadows or background: true alpha transparency including gaps between hair strands.
Read order: top-left NORMAL (calm relaxed closed mouth), top-middle HAPPY (clear warm open-mouth smile), top-right SURPRISED (wide eyes and small open mouth), bottom-left SAD (downcast eyes, sorrowful eyebrows, closed mouth), bottom-middle ANGRY (brows furrowed, firm mouth; mild displeasure, not violent), bottom-right SHY (small bashful smile and pink cheeks).
Only change facial expressions between copies; keep all non-face artwork consistent. Match the reference character rather than inventing a new anime girl. The emotion differences must be clearly legible at game scale.
Character details: Blue long hair with lighter blue tips, whale-fin ears and large whale tail, blue and white ruffled maid dress and headband, whale apron insignia, gold embroidery and original open-hand pose.
